title: National Security Cannot Be an Afterthought in Antitrust Enforcement
summary_en: Antitrust remedies can reshape U.S. tech leadership relative to China. National security experts should assess those consequences before the government commits to enforcement, not after.
title_cn: National Security Cannot Be an Afterthought in Antitrust Enforcement

title: South Korea: Export Nation or Ecosystem Power?
summary_en: This inaugural CESTA examines South Korea's most significant economic security challenges, the role of advanced technologies in shaping its national power, and opportunities to strengthen its position along with other market economies within the emerging economic order.
title_cn: South Korea: Export Nation or Ecosystem Power?

title: Post-Election Thoughts
summary_en: In this special edition of his weekly column, Bill Reinsch unpacks the results of the 2026 midterm elections and discusses how the Democratic majorities in the House and the Senate might approach trade policy in the next Congress.
